title: Rain or Shine
theme: Weather extremes in Disney films and parks
intro: [excited] Grab your poncho AND your sunscreen, because tonight's forecast is Rain or Shine! [laughs] We've got storms, heat waves, hurricanes, and one very soggy water park legend. Hold onto your hats!

art.prompt: A theme-park landscape split down the middle: one side blazing sunshine over a tropical lagoon with a surf wave, the other a wild thunderstorm with lightning, a shipwreck and swirling clouds, a rainbow arching between Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

categories.title: Hot and Cold Front
categories.intro: Our film category is Pixar's Elemental, where the locals ARE the weather. [chuckles] Fire, water, air and earth, all stuck on the same subway.

art.prompt: A glowing city of fire, water, earth and air districts at night, flickering flames, rippling water towers, leafy buildings and puffy cloud balconies, a canal reflecting it all Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: Ember Lumen, the hot-tempered hero of Elemental, is made of this element.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is fire! [excited] Ember has a temper. You'd be grumpy too if you could melt your chair.

clues.clue: Wade Ripple, the emotional city inspector who falls for Ember, is made of this.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is water! [laughs] Wade cries at EVERYTHING. Honestly, he's my favorite.

clues.clue: Elemental takes place in this metropolis where all four elements live together.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Element City! [cheerful] Picture New York, but some of the commuters are literally on fire.

clues.clue: Ember's family runs this convenience shop in Firetown.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Fireplace! [chuckles] Buy a snack, get a burn. That's a pun, not a review.

clues.clue: Ember's hardworking father, who built the family shop, has this first name.
clues.reveal: [impressed] The correct answer is Bernie! He brought the family's sacred Blue Flame from the old country. True nerds remember the bow.

categories.title: Under the Weather
categories.intro: Disney storytellers LOVE a good storm. [dramatic pause] Thunder, lightning, whirlpools... name the weather or the soggy survivor.

art.prompt: A stormy sea with a towering whirlpool, a tall sailing ship tilting in the waves, lightning bolts striking from purple clouds and wind swirling colorful leaves across the sky Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: Pocahontas asks if you can paint with all the colors of this.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the wind! [cheerful] Colors of the Wind won the Oscar. Still trying to find the paintbrush for that.

clues.clue: Ariel rescues this prince from the sea when a storm wrecks his ship.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Prince Eric! [laughs] Lightning, a burning ship, and he STILL had perfect hair.

clues.clue: Under Scar's rule, the Pride Lands suffer from this weather disaster.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is a drought! [sighs] No food, no water, and hyenas everywhere. Scar: terrible king, worse landlord.

clues.clue: Pirates of the Caribbean: At World's End climaxes with a ship battle inside this giant whirlpool.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the maelstrom! [gasps] A wedding in the middle of a sea battle. Captain Barbossa officiated. Romantic!

clues.clue: In Frozen 2, this playful wind spirit pushes Elsa and Anna around the Enchanted Forest.
clues.reveal: [impressed] The correct answer is Gale! [laughs] It loves stealing Olaf's carrot nose. Bruni is the fire salamander and the Nokk is the water horse.

categories.title: Forecast: Zoom
categories.intro: We're zooming in on a weather-related movie moment. Name the film before the picture zooms out! [whispers] Bring an umbrella just in case.

art.prompt: A vintage weather-station desk with a barometer, a spinning anemometer, rain gauge and a giant magnifying glass hovering over a tiny storm cloud Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: Name the film from this windy close-up.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Mary Poppins! [cheerful] When the wind changes, she arrives by umbrella. Better than any rideshare.

media.prompt: Extreme close-up of a black umbrella handle carved like a parrot's head, floating above London rooftops and chimneys on a windy cloudy day, no people or characters

clues.clue: Name the film from this stormy sail.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Moana! [laughs] She knows how far she'll go, just not how to tie a knot... yet.

media.prompt: Extreme close-up of an ocean-voyaging canoe's woven crab-claw sail snapping in the wind, dark storm clouds and towering turquoise waves behind, no people or characters

clues.clue: Name the film from this sky-high close-up.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Up! [gasps] Carl's house floats right through a thunderstorm. Nothing like a little turbulence.

media.prompt: Extreme close-up of thousands of colorful balloon strings tied to a chimney of a small wooden house drifting through a dark thunderstorm with lightning, no people or characters

clues.clue: Name the film from this twisty close-up.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Oz the Great and Powerful! [excited] Disney's 2013 prequel. A tornado swept a hot air balloon all the way to the Emerald City.

media.prompt: Extreme close-up of a striped hot air balloon basket caught in a swirling black-and-white tornado funnel, debris spinning around, a hint of emerald green light ahead, no people or characters

clues.clue: Name the film from this stormy shoreline.
clues.reveal: [impressed] The correct answer is Pete's Dragon! The 1977 original. When the lighthouse lamp goes out in a storm, a friendly dragon lights it again.

media.prompt: Extreme close-up of a seaside lighthouse lamp on a rocky Maine coast at night in a raging storm, waves crashing, an old wooden fishing boat struggling offshore, no people or characters

categories.title: The Blustery Bay Bulletin
categories.intro: Real photos from Walt Disney World's soggiest legend. [mischievously] A storm wrecked the place, and the locals just added lounge chairs.

art.prompt: A storm-wrecked tropical lagoon village with tin-roofed shacks, surfboards and a shrimp boat stuck on top of a volcanic peak, palm trees bent from the wind, a turquoise wave pool Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: Legend says a furious storm swept ships ashore to create this Walt Disney World water park.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Typhoon Lagoon! [excited] Instead of a certain and watery doom, the winds swept them here. Poetry AND lazy rivers.

clues.clue: This Typhoon Lagoon water coaster is themed to a storm-wrecked fruit company.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Crush 'n' Gusher! [laughs] Tropical Amity Fruit Exporters. Our juices are crushed with flavor!

clues.clue: Before each new set of waves rolls across this pool, Miss Tilly warns guests with this sound.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is a whistle! [chuckles] Miss Tilly's whistle means the next big set is coming. Surfers, assume the position.

clues.clue: The storm struck the tropical region of Blustery Bay and this resort village, which shared its name with calm palms.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Placid Palms! [sarcastic] Very placid... until it wasn't. Afterward the locals renamed it Leaning Palms.

media.prompt: A ruined tropical resort village after a storm, tin-roofed huts with patched roofs, palm trees bent sideways, surfboards wedged into rooftops, a shrimp boat on top of a volcanic peak in the distance, sunny blue sky, no people or characters

clues.clue: Miss Tilly's crew wrote a postcard to this bartender, now displayed in his Enchanted Tiki Bar at Disney's Polynesian Village Resort.
clues.reveal: [impressed] The correct answer is Trader Sam! [laughs] Storm survivors still keep in touch. Probably asking for a tow.

media.prompt: A dim, cozy tiki bar wall covered in vintage travel postcards, ship lanterns, carved tiki masks and a porthole window showing a stormy sea, no people or characters

categories.title: Sunny With a Chance of Trivia
categories.intro: Our wildcard is a forecast of fun. [cheerful] Mostly sunny, with a high chance of nerds. Carry an umbrella.

art.prompt: An old mill on a pond at the edge of a thunderstorm, sun rays breaking through clouds on one side, a red umbrella and a lost toy car in a rain puddle in the foreground Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: In Frozen, Olaf sings about all the things he'll do in this season.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is summer! [laughs] A snowman who dreams of hot sand. What could go wrong?

clues.clue: Blizzard Beach's mascot is this reptile wearing a scarf.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Ice Gator! [chuckles] A gator in a ski resort in Florida. Somehow it all makes sense.

clues.clue: Toy Story 4 opens with Woody rescuing this remote control car from a rainy storm drain.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is RC! [whispers] A rainy rescue. Then Bo Peep goes away. Pixar breaks our hearts in the first ten minutes again.

clues.clue: Mary Poppins arrives with the wind blowing from this direction.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the east! [dramatic pause] Wind's in the east, mist coming in... Bert can feel what's to happen.

clues.clue: This 1937 Silly Symphony shows a windmill in a thunderstorm and first used the multiplane camera.
clues.reveal: [impressed] The correct answer is The Old Mill! It won the Oscar and was a test run for Snow White. Big storm, bigger innovation.
